P037.title: Matrix coupled model for the vehicle–track interaction analysis featured to the railway crossing
P037.label: Xu等（2021）

complete_examples.text: It can be seen from Fig. 2 that the key for the crossing modelling is to define the crossing rail geometry along the wheel– rail contact points (marked as yellow lines).
To improve the smoothness in the development of the rail geometry, some additional critical sections are added according to the design of the crossing, as marked in red colour in Fig. 3.
